data.desc: flyExclusive, Inc. (NYSE American: FLYX) is a vertically integrated private aviation company providing private jet charter, Jet Club membership, fractional ownership and aircraft management services. Headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, the company operates one of the nation's largest private jet fleets, supported by comprehensive in-house maintenance, repair and overhaul, avionics, refurbishment and proprietary aviation technology capabilities.
